cc:Work.dc:description:
Hold a plane to a wall
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallPlaneHolder --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --walltype slatwall --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes WallPlaneHolder --walltype --reference --labels
